title: THE DESCENT, a first version (owner, 2026-10-15): the standalone cave game (BELOW, stalheart-cave) vendored under below/ and played in an iframe over the paused game after BOTH WALLS is secured, its outcome posted back; rescued and sacrifice go on to THE ENDING with Isao's decoding joke, a lost descent keeps the cave's own TRY AGAIN
context: Owner, 2026-10-15: '/Users/minikai/Dev/stalheart-cave we will bring this mission as the last mission; Isao must go into the Nest to set-up a nuke'; earlier the same day: 'at the end of that mission, ISAO will joke that he finally decoded the Alien language from what the Queen said when he set-up a nuke in her nest... My Nest, you out, and then words that seem to mean excrement'. Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-descent-mission-design.md, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-descent-mission.md. BELOW (stalheart-below 0.8, its own repo kai-denrei/stalheart-cave) is a complete standalone game: the player flies ISAO down Stalheart's sinkhole into the Queen's chamber, places the charge, flies out; three outcomes (rescued, sacrifice, lost); static files, no network, its own three.js; it shares no code with the game. The run's state (the base, the reports, the campaign board's clips) lives in the game's page, so a navigation away would lose it.
outcome: In the cave's repo (commit 2d5c916 there): src/handoff.js (parseMode, endingAction, postOutcome) and a ?stalheart=1 mode: the briefing is the campaign's own card (TAKE THE FEED; the one click the audio context needs), the wordmark link hidden, the ending's button RETURN TO THE SURFACE posts { below: outcome } to the parent window; a lost descent keeps TRY AGAIN; test/stalheart-mode.test.mjs. In Stalheart: scripts/import-below.mjs copies the cave's page (index.html, src, vendor, assets, ASSETS.md, assets.lock.json) from its clean tree into below/ with below/BELOW.lock.json { source, commit, date, files, bytes } (83 files, 9.05 MB at 2d5c916); scripts/build.mjs ships below/ into dist/below/ as it is (test/import-below.mjs). src/content/descent.js DESCENT { page below/index.html?stalheart=1, outcomes, brief/back/last, mobileSkip }. src/domain/descent.js (pure): descentDue (secure + the final sector, not on a phone), descentResult (the message validated), descentNext (ending or retry). src/fx/descent-host.js: begin(then) says the brief, pauses the game, opens the page in an iframe over the tab (allow pointer-lock, autoplay, fullscreen; styles.css .descent-frame), listens for the outcome; on rescued or sacrifice the frame goes, the game runs, the joke (descent_back, or descent_last as his last transmission) and `then` plays the ending; on lost the frame stays; report(outcome) for the harness. src/fx/sector-run.js finish: on the final sector's SECURE the descent is asked before the finale (api.descent(fin), else fin()). src/td-tab.js: the host, storyApi.descent, state().descent, the hooks descentNow and descentReport. src/isaobriefs.js: descent_brief, descent_back, descent_last as captions; ~/Dev/seiyu_voice/ISAO-VOICE-LINES.md section 17 (the three triggers, for the owner to record). Not in this version: the joke queued inside the finale's own line order (it is said as the brief before the finale), a UNIT LOST note on the campaign board for a sacrifice, a loss on a lost descent (a retry for now), mobile (skipped with the brief).
alternatives: Navigate to the cave and back with the outcome in the URL: rejected; the run's state lives in the page and would be lost.
Port the cave into the game's renderer: rejected for tonight; the cave is a whole game with its own flight, cave and Queen; the iframe keeps it intact and the owner's repo its source of truth.
A loss on a lost descent: not done; the owner decides; descentNext is the one line.
Vendor the cave as a git submodule: rejected; Pages builds from the checked-in tree, and the voice import's pattern (a copy with a lock) is what the project does.
evidence: in stalheart-cave: npm test (33), npm run check; here: node test/descent.mjs, test/import-below.mjs, test/isaobriefs.mjs, test/host-contracts.mjs (56 factories), test/sector-run.mjs; npm test, npm run check, npm run build (dist/below/ present)

browser, 2026-10-16: --descent green: below/index.html?stalheart=1 served beside the game, descentNow() opens the frame over the tab (pointer-lock allowed) with the game paused, the cave boots inside it in its stalheart mode (its card INITIALIZING FEED then TAKE THE FEED), a lost outcome keeps the frame, rescued removes it, the game runs again, the brief then the decoding joke asked (descent.said).
